crossRefs.note: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it…
Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.

translations.web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
translations.bsb: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
translations.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
translations.asv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.
